question: In a certain code language, 'RIVER' is written as 'SJWFS' and 'BROWN' is written as 'CSPXO". How will PRESS' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series. So, • 'RIVER' is written as 'SJWFS' ​
